---
execute:
  echo: false
title: "Billboard Graphic"
---

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(tidyverse))
```

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
billboard_long <- billboard |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("wk"),
    names_to = "week",
    values_to = "rank",
    values_drop_na = TRUE
  ) |>
  mutate(
    week_num = parse_number(week),
    chart_date = date.entered + weeks(week_num - 1),
    rank = as.numeric(rank)
  ) |>
  arrange(artist, track, week_num)

selected_songs <- billboard_long |>
  group_by(artist, track) |>
  summarise(best_rank = min(rank), .groups = "drop") |>
  slice_min(order_by = best_rank, n = 10) |>
  mutate(song_label = paste(artist, track, sep = " - "))

billboard_long |>
  semi_join(selected_songs, by = c("artist", "track")) |>
  mutate(song_label = paste(artist, track, sep = " - ")) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = chart_date, y = rank, group = song_label, color = song_label)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.9, alpha = 0.9) +
  geom_point(size = 1.2, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_y_reverse() +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
  labs(
    title = "Billboard chart trajectories for selected songs",
    subtitle = "Lower rank values mean a higher position on the chart",
    x = "Chart date",
    y = "Billboard rank",
    color = "Song"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "grey30"),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )
```
